reason: A DSH Web UI sidebar for discovering plugins through GitHub-based trending and curated topic leaderboards, with caching, reminders, and host-mediated one-click installation.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 侧栏中浏览基于 GitHub 数据的热门与精选插件榜单，并支持查看详情和一键安装。
summaries.en: Browse GitHub-based trending and curated plugin leaderboards in a DSH Web UI sidebar, with details and one-click installation.

capabilities: Queries GitHub Search and repository metadata APIs
Fetches README and package metadata from raw.githubusercontent.com
Displays cached plugin rankings and topic-based collections in a sidebar panel
Stores settings, observations, cache data, and optional GitHub token in browser localStorage
Schedules optional automatic refreshes and pop-up reminders
Requests host-side installation of selected plugins through a local API endpoint
